+module
+
+public import Sunflower.Basic
+public import Sunflower.ReductionEstimates
+
+/-!
+# From vector sunflowers to sunflowers of sets
+
+Finite averaging and block transversals for Proposition 8 of the manuscript.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Pointwise
+
+namespace Sunflower
+
+public section
+
+/-- Double counting for a finite transitive action. If every translate of a
+test family meets `A` in at most `M` points, the density of `A` is at most
+`M / B.card`. Written without division, this includes empty sets. -/
+theorem transitive_action_double_count
+    {Γ X : Type*} [Group Γ] [Fintype Γ] [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
+    [MulAction Γ X] [MulAction.IsPretransitive Γ X]
+    (A B : Finset X) (M : ℝ)
+    (hbound : ∀ g : Γ, ((B.filter (fun x => g • x ∈ A)).card : ℝ) ≤ M) :
+    (A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card X : ℝ) * M := by
+  classical
+  have hM : 0 ≤ M := (Nat.cast_nonneg _).trans (hbound 1)
+  rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩
+  · simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
+    positivity
+  let w (x : X) : ℝ := ∑ g : Γ, if g • x ∈ A then 1 else 0
+  have hw (x y : X) : w x = w y := by
+    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq Γ x y
+    simpa [w, mul_smul] using
+      (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulRight g)
+        (fun h : Γ => if h • x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)).symm
+  have hsum (g : Γ) :
+      (∑ x : X, if g • x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = A.card := by
+    calc
+      _ = ∑ x : X, if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
+        Equiv.sum_comp (MulAction.toPerm g) _
+      _ = _ := by simp
+  have hall : (Fintype.card X : ℝ) * w b₀ =
+      (Fintype.card Γ : ℝ) * (A.card : ℝ) := by
+    calc
+      _ = ∑ x : X, w b₀ := by simp
+      _ = ∑ x : X, w x := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => (hw x b₀).symm)
+      _ = ∑ g : Γ, ∑ x : X, if g • x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
+        Finset.sum_comm
+      _ = _ := by simp_rw [hsum]; simp
+  have htest : (B.card : ℝ) * w b₀ ≤ (Fintype.card Γ : ℝ) * M := by
+    calc
+      _ = ∑ b ∈ B, w b₀ := by simp
+      _ = ∑ b ∈ B, w b := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => (hw b b₀).symm)
+      _ = ∑ g : Γ, ∑ b ∈ B, if g • b ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
+        Finset.sum_comm
+      _ = ∑ g : Γ, ((B.filter (fun b => g • b ∈ A)).card : ℝ) := by simp
+      _ ≤ ∑ _g : Γ, M := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun g _ => hbound g)
+      _ = _ := by simp
+  have hgpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Γ := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
+  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hgpos).mp
+  calc
+    (Fintype.card Γ : ℝ) * ((A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ)) =
+        ((Fintype.card X : ℝ) * w b₀) * (B.card : ℝ) := by rw [hall]; ring
+    _ = (Fintype.card X : ℝ) * ((B.card : ℝ) * w b₀) := by ring
+    _ ≤ (Fintype.card X : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card Γ : ℝ) * M) :=
+      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htest (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
+    _ = _ := by ring
+
+variable {t D r : ℕ} {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
+
+/-- The ground set of `t` ordered `D`-element blocks and `r` fixed elements. -/
+abbrev BlockDomain (t D r : ℕ) := (Fin t × Fin D) ⊕ Fin r
+
+/-- Choose the entry specified by a vector from each of the ordered blocks. -/
+def blockGraphEmbedding (x : Fin t → Fin D) : Fin t ↪ BlockDomain t D r where
+  toFun i := Sum.inl (i, x i)
+  inj' := by
+    intro i j h
+    exact congrArg Prod.fst (Sum.inl.inj h)
+
+/-- Include the fixed part of the transversal construction. -/
+def blockRemainderEmbedding : Fin r ↪ BlockDomain t D r where
+  toFun := Sum.inr
+  inj' := Sum.inr_injective
+
+/-- A vector becomes a set by selecting one point per block and adjoining
+the common remainder. The embedding provides disjointness of all blocks. -/
+def blockEncode (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α) (x : Fin t → Fin D) : Finset α :=
+  ((Finset.univ.map (blockGraphEmbedding x)) ∪
+    (Finset.univ.map blockRemainderEmbedding)).map e
+
+@[simp]
+theorem mem_blockEncode_inl (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α)
+    (x : Fin t → Fin D) (i : Fin t) (d : Fin D) :
+    e (Sum.inl (i, d)) ∈ blockEncode e x ↔ x i = d := by
+  classical
+  simp [blockEncode, blockGraphEmbedding, blockRemainderEmbedding]
+  change (∃ a : Fin t, (Sum.inl (a, x a) : BlockDomain t D r) =
+    Sum.inl (i, d)) ↔ x i = d
+  simp
+
+@[simp]
+theorem mem_blockEncode_inr (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α)
+    (x : Fin t → Fin D) (j : Fin r) :
+    e (Sum.inr j) ∈ blockEncode e x := by
+  classical
+  simp [blockEncode, blockGraphEmbedding, blockRemainderEmbedding]
+
+theorem blockEncode_injective (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α) :
+    Function.Injective (blockEncode e) := by
+  classical
+  intro x y hxy
+  funext i
+  have hx : e (Sum.inl (i, x i)) ∈ blockEncode e x := by simp
+  rw [hxy] at hx
+  exact (mem_blockEncode_inl e y i (x i)).mp hx |>.symm
+
+@[simp]
+theorem card_blockEncode (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α)
+    (x : Fin t → Fin D) : (blockEncode e x).card = t + r := by
+  classical
+  have hd : Disjoint (Finset.univ.map (blockGraphEmbedding (r := r) x))
+      (Finset.univ.map (blockRemainderEmbedding (t := t) (D := D))) := by
+    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
+    intro z hz hz'
+    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
+    obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz'
+    have heq := hi.trans hj.symm
+    simp [blockGraphEmbedding, blockRemainderEmbedding] at heq
+  simp [blockEncode, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd]
+
+/-- A point occurring in two distinct members of a vector sunflower belongs
+to every encoded member. This includes the common fixed remainder. -/
+theorem blockEncode_pair_mem {k : ℕ} (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α)
+    (x : Fin k → Fin t → Fin D) (hx : VectorPattern x)
+    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) {v : α}
+    (hi : v ∈ blockEncode e (x i)) (hj : v ∈ blockEncode e (x j)) :
+    ∀ l, v ∈ blockEncode e (x l) := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hi
+  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hz with hz | hz
+  · obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
+    change e (Sum.inl (c, x i c)) ∈ blockEncode e (x j) at hj
+    have hji : x j c = x i c := (mem_blockEncode_inl e (x j) c (x i c)).mp hj
+    rcases hx c with hm | hd
+    · intro l
+      change e (Sum.inl (c, x i c)) ∈ blockEncode e (x l)
+      exact (mem_blockEncode_inl e (x l) c (x i c)).mpr (hm l i)
+    · exact (hij (hd hji.symm)).elim
+  · obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
+    intro l
+    exact mem_blockEncode_inr e (x l) q
+
+/-- Block transversals send vector sunflowers to ordinary set sunflowers. -/
+theorem blockEncode_setPattern {k : ℕ} [Fintype α]
+    (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α) (x : Fin k → Fin t → Fin D)
+    (hx : VectorPattern x) : SetPattern (fun i => blockEncode e (x i)) := by
+  classical
+  refine ⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ∀ i, v ∈ blockEncode e (x i)), ?_⟩
+  intro i j hij
+  ext v
+  simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
+  exact ⟨fun h => blockEncode_pair_mem e x hx hij h.1 h.2,
+    fun h => ⟨h i, h j⟩⟩
+
+/-- Relabelling a block encoding composes its ground-set embedding. -/
+theorem smul_blockEncode (g : Equiv.Perm α) (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α)
+    (x : Fin t → Fin D) :
+    g • blockEncode e x = blockEncode (e.trans g.toEmbedding) x := by
+  classical
+  simp [blockEncode, Finset.smul_finset_def, Finset.map_eq_image,
+    Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]
+
+/-- Pulling a sunflower-free family back to a block-transversal cube gives
+a vector-sunflower-free family. -/
+theorem block_preimage_sunflowerFree {k : ℕ} [Fintype α]
+    (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α) (F : Finset (Finset α))
+    (hF : SetSunflowerFree k F) :
+    VectorSunflowerFree k
+      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin t → Fin D => blockEncode e x ∈ F)) := by
+  classical
+  intro x hx hinj hpat
+  exact hF (fun i => blockEncode e (x i))
+    (fun i => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hx i)).2)
+    ((blockEncode_injective e).comp hinj) (blockEncode_setPattern e x hpat)
+
+/-- The vector estimate bounds every translated transversal cube, including
+the zero-coordinate case, where the cube contains just one set. -/
+theorem card_block_preimage_le {k : ℕ} [Fintype α]
+    (C : ℝ)
+    (hvec : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → ∀ V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D),
+      VectorSunflowerFree k V → (V.card : ℝ) ≤ C ^ n)
+    (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ α) (F : Finset (Finset α))
+    (hF : SetSunflowerFree k F) :
+    ((Finset.univ.filter
+      (fun x : Fin t → Fin D => blockEncode e x ∈ F)).card : ℝ) ≤ C ^ t := by
+  classical
+  by_cases ht : 1 ≤ t
+  · exact hvec t ht _ (block_preimage_sunflowerFree e F hF)
+  · have ht0 : t = 0 := by omega
+    subst t
+    have h := card_vector_family_le
+      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin 0 → Fin D => blockEncode e x ∈ F))
+    norm_num only [pow_zero] at h ⊢
+    exact_mod_cast h
+
+/-- The permutation-averaging estimate for a fixed layer and a fixed
+collection of disjoint blocks. The statement avoids division. -/
+theorem layer_card_mul_pow_le {k N : ℕ}
+    (C : ℝ)
+    (hvec : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → ∀ V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D),
+      VectorSunflowerFree k V → (V.card : ℝ) ≤ C ^ n)
+    (e : BlockDomain t D r ↪ Fin N) (F : Finset (Finset (Fin N)))
+    (hF : SetSunflowerFree k F) :
+    ((F.filter (fun S => S.card = t + r)).card : ℝ) * (D : ℝ) ^ t ≤
+      (Nat.choose N (t + r) : ℝ) * C ^ t := by
+  classical
+  let X := Set.powersetCard (Fin N) (t + r)
+  let A : Finset X := Finset.univ.filter (fun S => S.val ∈ F)
+  let φ : (Fin t → Fin D) → X := fun x =>
+    ⟨blockEncode e x, card_blockEncode e x⟩
+  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := by
+    intro x y h
+    exact blockEncode_injective e (congrArg Subtype.val h)
+  let B : Finset X := Finset.univ.image φ
+  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) X :=
+    Set.powersetCard.isPretransitive
+  have hB : B.card = D ^ t := by
+    simp [B, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hφ]
+  have hA : A.card = (F.filter (fun S => S.card = t + r)).card := by
+    apply Finset.card_bij (fun S _ => S.val)
+    · intro S hS
+      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2, S.property⟩
+    · intro S _ T _ hST
+      exact Subtype.ext hST
+    · intro S hS
+      refine ⟨⟨S, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
+      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).1⟩
+  have hX : Fintype.card X = Nat.choose N (t + r) := by
+    change Fintype.card (Set.powersetCard (Fin N) (t + r)) = _
+    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Set.powersetCard.card]
+    simp
+  have hbound (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) :
+      ((B.filter (fun S => g • S ∈ A)).card : ℝ) ≤ C ^ t := by
+    have hmem (x : Fin t → Fin D) :
+        g • φ x ∈ A ↔ blockEncode (e.trans g.toEmbedding) x ∈ F := by

+/-- The layer estimate in Proposition 8. The exponent is the maximum number

+theorem layer_card_le {k D N s : ℕ}

+module
+
+public import Sunflower.Estimates
+
+/-! Summing the layer bounds in the vector-to-set reduction. -/
+
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Sunflower
+
+/-- Replacing the minimum of an integer and a floor by two geometric terms. -/
+theorem power_min_div_le (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
+    (d N s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
+    ρ ^ min s ((N - s) / d) ≤
+      ρ ^ s + ρ⁻¹ * (ρ ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ (N - s) := by
+  let y : ℝ := ρ ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)
+  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := Real.rpow_nonneg hρ0.le _
+  have hy1 : y ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hρ0.le hρ1 (by positivity)
+  have hypow : y ^ d = ρ := Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hρ0.le (by omega)
+  have hfloor : ρ ^ ((N - s) / d) ≤ ρ⁻¹ * y ^ (N - s) := by
+    have hmul : ρ ^ ((N - s) / d) * ρ ≤ y ^ (N - s) := by
+      calc
+        ρ ^ ((N - s) / d) * ρ = (y ^ d) ^ ((N - s) / d + 1) := by
+          rw [hypow, pow_succ]
+        _ = y ^ (d * ((N - s) / d + 1)) := (pow_mul _ _ _).symm
+        _ ≤ y ^ (N - s) := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hy0 hy1 (Nat.lt_mul_div_succ _ hd).le
+    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hρ0).mpr hmul
+    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hh
+  change ρ ^ min s ((N - s) / d) ≤ ρ ^ s + ρ⁻¹ * y ^ (N - s)
+  by_cases hs : s ≤ (N - s) / d
+  · rw [min_eq_left hs]
+    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
+  · rw [min_eq_right (by omega : (N - s) / d ≤ s)]
+    exact hfloor.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg hρ0.le _))
+
+/-- The geometric summation that is the analytic part of Proposition 8. -/
+theorem binomial_layer_sum_bound (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
+    (d N : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
+    (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * ρ ^ min s ((N - s) / d)) ≤
+      (1 + ρ⁻¹) * (1 + ρ ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ N := by
+  let y : ℝ := ρ ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)
+  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := Real.rpow_nonneg hρ0.le _
+  have hy1 : y ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hρ0.le hρ1 (by positivity)
+  have hypow : y ^ d = ρ := Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hρ0.le (by omega)
+  have hρy : ρ ≤ y := by rw [← hypow]; exact pow_le_of_le_one hy0 hy1 (by omega)
+  have hbin1 : (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * ρ ^ s) = (1 + ρ) ^ N := by
+    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm] using (add_pow ρ 1 N).symm
+  have hbin2 : (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * y ^ (N - s)) = (1 + y) ^ N := by
+    simpa [mul_comm] using (add_pow 1 y N).symm
+  change _ ≤ (1 + ρ⁻¹) * (1 + y) ^ N
+  calc
+    _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) *
+          (ρ ^ s + ρ⁻¹ * y ^ (N - s)) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro s hs
+      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (power_min_div_le ρ hρ0 hρ1 d N s hd)
+      positivity
+    _ = (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * ρ ^ s) +
+        ρ⁻¹ * (∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * y ^ (N - s)) := by
+      simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
+      congr 1
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro s hs
+      ring
+    _ = (1 + ρ) ^ N + ρ⁻¹ * (1 + y) ^ N := by rw [hbin1, hbin2]
+    _ ≤ (1 + ρ⁻¹) * (1 + y) ^ N := by
+      have hpow : (1 + ρ) ^ N ≤ (1 + y) ^ N := by gcongr
+      nlinarith
+
+/-- Layer bounds imply the full-family estimate in Proposition 8. -/
+theorem card_le_from_layer_bounds (D N : ℕ) (hD : 2 ≤ D)
+    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
+    (F : Finset (Finset (Fin N)))
+    (hlayer : ∀ s : ℕ, s ≤ N →
+      ((F.filter (fun S => S.card = s)).card : ℝ) ≤
+        (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * ρ ^ min s ((N - s) / (D - 1))) :
+    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + ρ⁻¹) * (1 + ρ ^ (1 / ((D : ℝ) - 1))) ^ N := by
+  classical
+  have hpartition : F.card = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (F.filter (fun S => S.card = s)).card := by
+    apply Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
+    intro S hS
+    have hcard : S.card ≤ N := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ S
+    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
+  have hpartR : (F.card : ℝ) = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ((F.filter (fun S => S.card = s)).card : ℝ) := by
+    exact_mod_cast hpartition
+  have hd : 0 < D - 1 := by omega
+  have hcast : ((D - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (D : ℝ) - 1 := by
+    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ D), Nat.cast_one]
+  calc
+    (F.card : ℝ) = _ := hpartR
+    _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Nat.choose N s : ℝ) * ρ ^ min s ((N - s) / (D - 1)) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro s hs
+      exact hlayer s (by simpa using Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hs))
+    _ ≤ (1 + ρ⁻¹) * (1 + ρ ^ (((D - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ N :=
+      binomial_layer_sum_bound ρ hρ0 hρ1 (D - 1) N hd
+    _ = (1 + ρ⁻¹) * (1 + ρ ^ (1 / ((D : ℝ) - 1))) ^ N := by rw [hcast, one_div]
+
+end Sunflower"},{"sha":"bbc72778e4cfe690ec4f71b94aa723155b216b46","filename":"Sunflower/Tensor.lean","status":"added","additions":154,"deletions":0,"changes":154,"blob_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/blob/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/Sunflower%2FTensor.lean","raw_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/raw/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/Sunflower%2FTensor.lean","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/contents/Sunflower%2FTensor.lean?ref=8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+module
+
+public import Sunflower.Basic
+public import Sunflower.ExpansionDefs
+public import Sunflower.CommonSpace
+public import Sunflower.Counting
+
+/-!
+# Tensoring the local interpolation construction
+
+Each local monomial has a low exponent in one of the last `m` variables.
+After multiplying in `n` coordinates, one of those variables has at least
+`n/m` low coordinates. This is the combinatorial step in Lemma 7.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+namespace Sunflower
+
+/-- The product of a local tester over all coordinates. -/
+def tensor {m n D : ℕ} (q : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin D) → ℚ)
+    (x : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → Fin D) : ℚ :=
+  ∏ r, q (fun i => x i r)
+
+/-- Products of nonzero local testers test the vector sunflower relation. -/
+theorem tensor_ne_zero_iff {m n D : ℕ}
+    (q : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin D) → ℚ)
+    (hq : ∀ a, q a ≠ 0 ↔ (∀ i, a i = a 0) ∨ Function.Injective a)
+    (x : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → Fin D) :
+    tensor q x ≠ 0 ↔ VectorPattern x := by
+  classical
+  simp only [tensor, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, forall_const]
+  constructor
+  · intro h r
+    rcases (hq _).mp (h r) with hmono | hinj
+    · exact Or.inl (fun i j => (hmono i).trans (hmono j).symm)
+    · exact Or.inr hinj
+  · intro h r
+    apply (hq _).mpr
+    rcases h r with hmono | hinj
+    · exact Or.inl (fun i => hmono i 0)
+    · exact Or.inr hinj
+
+/-- A polynomial row evaluates one ordinary monomial on one vector. -/
+def monomial {n D : ℕ} (d : Fin n → Fin D) (x : Fin n → Fin D) : ℚ :=
+  ∏ r, ((x r).val : ℚ) ^ (d r).val
+
+/-- Some row of every product term belongs to the common exponent family. -/
+theorem exists_good_row {m n D : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
+    {q : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin D) → ℚ} (E : LowExpansion m D q)
+    (t : Fin n → E.Term) :
+    ∃ i : Fin m, (fun r => E.exponent (t r) i.succ) ∈ goodExponents (m + 1) n D := by
+  classical
+  let : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hm⟩⟩
+  let S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n) := fun i =>
+    Finset.univ.filter (fun r => (E.exponent (t r) i.succ).val < m)
+  have hcover : Finset.univ.biUnion S = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) := by
+    ext r
+    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]
+    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := E.low (t r)
+    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ r, hi⟩⟩
+  have hsum : n ≤ ∑ i, (S i).card := by
+    simpa only [hcover, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
+      (Finset.card_biUnion_le (s := Finset.univ) (t := S))
+  have hmul : (∑ _i : Fin m, n) ≤ ∑ i, m * (S i).card := by
+    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
+      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hsum
+  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le Finset.univ_nonempty hmul
+  exact ⟨i, by simpa [goodExponents, S] using hi⟩
+
+/-- The finite product expands into a finite sum of global monomials. -/
+theorem tensor_expand {m n D : ℕ}
+    {q : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin D) → ℚ} (E : LowExpansion m D q)
+    (x : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n → Fin D) :
+    tensor q x = ∑ t : Fin n → E.Term,
+      (∏ r, E.coefficient (t r)) *
+        ∏ i, monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) i) (x i) := by
+  classical
+  simp only [tensor, E.expand]
+  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro t _
+  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_comm]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The tensor obtained from a local low-exponent expansion bounds every
+vector-sunflower-free family by the number of good exponent vectors. -/
+theorem card_le_goodExponents_of_expansion {m n D : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
+    (q : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin D) → ℚ)
+    (hq : ∀ a, q a ≠ 0 ↔ (∀ i, a i = a 0) ∨ Function.Injective a)
+    (E : LowExpansion m D q) (V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D))
+    (hV : VectorSunflowerFree (m + 1) V) :
+    V.card ≤ (goodExponents (m + 1) n D).card := by
+  classical
+  let T := Fin n → E.Term
+  let slot : T → Fin m := fun t => Classical.choose (exists_good_row hm E t)
+  let index : T → goodExponents (m + 1) n D := fun t =>
+    ⟨fun r => E.exponent (t r) (slot t).succ,
+      Classical.choose_spec (exists_good_row hm E t)⟩
+  let p : goodExponents (m + 1) n D → V → ℚ :=
+    fun d a => monomial d.val a.val
+  let f : V → (Fin m → V) → ℚ := fun a x =>
+    tensor q (fun i => (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => V) a x i).val)
+  let G : T → V → (Fin m → V) → ℚ := fun t a x =>
+    (∏ r, E.coefficient (t r)) *
+      monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) 0) a.val *
+      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase (slot t),
+        monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) i.succ) (x i).val
+  have hdiag : ∀ a x, f a x ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ i, x i = a := by
+    intro a x
+    change tensor q (fun i => (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => V) a x i).val) ≠ 0 ↔ _
+    rw [tensor_ne_zero_iff q hq,
+      vectorPattern_iff_monochromatic hV (fun i => (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => V) a x i).property)]
+    constructor
+    · intro h i
+      exact Subtype.ext (h i.succ 0)
+    · intro h
+      have heq : Fin.cons (α := fun _ => V) a x = fun _ => a := by
+        funext i
+        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
+        · rfl
+        · exact h j
+      intro i j
+      simp only [heq]
+  have hdecomp : ∀ a x, f a x = ∑ t, p (index t) (x (slot t)) * G t a x := by
+    intro a x
+    change tensor q (fun i => (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => V) a x i).val) = _
+    rw [tensor_expand E]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro t _
+    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
+    simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
+    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
+      (fun i : Fin m => monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) i.succ) (x i).val)
+      (Finset.mem_univ (slot t))]
+    change _ = monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) (slot t).succ) (x (slot t)).val *
+      ((∏ r, E.coefficient (t r)) *
+        monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) 0) a.val *
+        ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase (slot t),
+          monomial (fun r => E.exponent (t r) i.succ) (x i).val)
+    ring
+  have hindep : ∀ t a x b, G t a (Function.update x (slot t) b) = G t a x := by
+    intro t a x b
+    dsimp [G]
+    congr 1
+    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
+    intro i hi
+    rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1]
+  have h := common_space_card_le_terms f p slot index G hdiag hdecomp hindep
+  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using h
+
+end Sunflower"},{"sha":"2fddcee7324cb3168389fd4e0e2b9e97e2da2c93","filename":"Sunflower/VectorBound.lean","status":"added","additions":55,"deletions":0,"changes":55,"blob_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/blob/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/Sunflower%2FVectorBound.lean","raw_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/raw/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/Sunflower%2FVectorBound.lean","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/contents/Sunflower%2FVectorBound.lean?ref=8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+module
+
+public import Sunflower.Tensor
+public import Sunflower.GridExpansion
+public import Sunflower.Estimates
+
+/-! # The vector sunflower theorem -/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Sunflower
+
+/-- If the alphabet is smaller than the low-degree threshold, every exponent
+vector is in the common exponent space. -/
+theorem goodExponents_eq_univ_of_small {m n D : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hD : D ≤ m) :
+    goodExponents (m + 1) n D = Finset.univ := by
+  classical
+  apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
+  intro d _
+  have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : Fin n => (d r).val < m)) =
+      Finset.univ := by
+    apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
+    intro r _
+    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (d r).isLt hD
+  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, hfilter, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
+  simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right n hm
+
+/-- The common exponent space bounds every vector-sunflower-free family. -/
+theorem vector_card_le_goodExponents (k n D : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k)
+    (V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D)) (hV : VectorSunflowerFree k V) :
+    V.card ≤ (goodExponents k n D).card := by
+  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
+  have hm : 2 ≤ m := by omega
+  by_cases hD : m ≤ D
+  · obtain ⟨q, _, hq, ⟨E⟩⟩ := exists_lowExpansion hm hD
+    exact card_le_goodExponents_of_expansion (by omega) q hq E V hV
+  · rw [goodExponents_eq_univ_of_small (by omega : 0 < m) (by omega : D ≤ m)]
+    exact Finset.card_le_univ V
+
+/-- **Theorem 2, integral-power form.** The formalization also permits `n=0`. -/
+theorem vector_card_pow_bound (k n D : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hD : 1 ≤ D)
+    (V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D)) (hV : VectorSunflowerFree k V) :
+    V.card ^ (k - 1) ≤ (4 * k ^ 2) ^ n * D ^ ((k - 2) * n) := by

+    (V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D)) (hV : VectorSunflowerFree k V) :
+    (V.card : ℝ) ≤ vectorBase k D ^ n := by

+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate the six-page verification report from retained evidence; no proof rebuild.
+
+From the repository root:
+    python3 -m pip install -r docs/report-requirements.txt
+    python3 docs/make-verification-report.py --output docs/erdos_szemeredi_lean_verification.pdf
+
+Inputs are the retained verification records, dependency manifest and proof
+sources. Mathematical text is an account of that exact reviewed snapshot.
+The script rejects changed proof-source hashes, missing final declarations,
+nonzero checker exits, or unexpected axiom dependencies before authoring.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import argparse
+from functools import partial
+from hashlib import sha256
+from io import BytesIO
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
+
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use('Agg')
+from matplotlib import font_manager, mathtext
+from reportlab.lib import colors
+from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
+from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
+from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
+from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
+from reportlab.pdfgen.canvas import Canvas
+from reportlab.platypus import (BaseDocTemplate, Frame, PageTemplate, Paragraph,
+                               Spacer, PageBreak, Table, TableStyle)
+from svglib.svglib import svg2rlg
+
+PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATE = '20 October 2026'
+NAVY = colors.HexColor('#17314B')
+INK = colors.HexColor('#263445')
+TEAL = colors.HexColor('#087F83')
+MUTED = colors.HexColor('#56677A')
+PALE = colors.HexColor('#F0F5F8')
+GREEN = colors.HexColor('#196447')
+GREEN_BG = colors.HexColor('#EAF4EF')
+AMBER = colors.HexColor('#855917')
+AMBER_BG = colors.HexColor('#FFF4DE')
+RULE = colors.HexColor('#D5DEE5')
+PAGE_W, PAGE_H = A4
+MARGIN = 43
+WIDTH = PAGE_W - 2*MARGIN
+
+
+def read_json(name):
+    return json.loads((PROJECT/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_evidence():
+    direct = read_json('verification/direct-kernels.json')
+    export = read_json('verification/export-summary.json')
+    surface = read_json('verification/statement-surface-comparison.json')
+    preflight = read_json('verification/local-preflight.json')
+    source = read_json('verification/source-preflight.json')
+    policy = read_json('scripts/policy-provenance.json')
+    manifest = read_json('lake-manifest.json')
+    build = read_json('verification/build.json')
+    assert direct['all_checkers_exit_zero'] and direct['sources_unchanged']
+    assert all(v['exit_code'] == 0 for v in direct['checks'].values())
+    assert all(export['requested_theorems_present'].values())
+    assert set(export['axioms']) == {'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}
+    assert export['unsafe_top_level_declarations'] == []
+    assert surface['all_match']
+    for name, expected in direct['source_sha256_after'].items():
+        assert digest(PROJECT/name) == expected, f'Proof source changed since replay: {name}'
+    assert source['source_status'] == 'pass'
+    assert build['exit_code'] == 0 and build['kind'] == 'final incremental project build'
+    mathlib = next(p for p in manifest['packages'] if p['name']=='mathlib')
+    return direct, export, surface, preflight, source, policy, mathlib
+
+
+def register_fonts():
+    fonts = [('Body','DejaVu Sans','normal','normal'),
+             ('BodyBold','DejaVu Sans','normal','bold'),
+             ('BodyItalic','DejaVu Sans','italic','normal'),
+             ('Mono','DejaVu Sans Mono','normal','normal')]
+    for name, family, style, weight in fonts:
+        path = font_manager.findfont(font_manager.FontProperties(family=family,style=style,weight=weight))
+        pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(name,path))
+    pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily('Body',normal='Body',bold='BodyBold',italic='BodyItalic',boldItalic='BodyBold')
+    matplotlib.rcParams.update({'svg.fonttype':'path','mathtext.fontset':'stix'})
+
+
+STYLES = {}
+
+def initialize_styles():
+    STYLES.update({
+      'body': ParagraphStyle('body',fontName='Body',fontSize=9.7,leading=13.8,textColor=INK,spaceAfter=7),
+      'small': ParagraphStyle('small',fontName='Body',fontSize=8.5,leading=12,textColor=MUTED,spaceAfter=6),
+      'tiny': ParagraphStyle('tiny',fontName='Body',fontSize=7.6,leading=10.6,textColor=MUTED,spaceAfter=5),
+      'h1': ParagraphStyle('h1',fontName='BodyBold',fontSize=23,leading=28,textColor=NAVY,spaceAfter=12),
+      'h2': ParagraphStyle('h2',fontName='BodyBold',fontSize=12.3,leading=16,textColor=NAVY,spaceBefore=10,spaceAfter=7),
+      'h3': ParagraphStyle('h3',fontName='BodyBold',fontSize=10.2,leading=14,textColor=TEAL,spaceBefore=7,spaceAfter=5),
+      'label': ParagraphStyle('label',fontName='BodyBold',fontSize=8.8,leading=12,textColor=TEAL,spaceAfter=7),
+      'table': ParagraphStyle('table',fontName='Body',fontSize=8.6,leading=12,textColor=INK,spaceAfter=0),
+      'tablehead': ParagraphStyle('tablehead',fontName='BodyBold',fontSize=8.4,leading=11.5,textColor=NAVY,spaceAfter=0),
+      'mono': ParagraphStyle('mono',fontName='Mono',fontSize=8.2,leading=12,textColor=INK,spaceAfter=0),
+      'hash': ParagraphStyle('hash',fontName='Mono',fontSize=7.1,leading=10.2,textColor=INK,spaceAfter=0),
+      'url': ParagraphStyle('url',fontName='Body',fontSize=7.8,leading=10.5,textColor=TEAL,spaceAfter=6,splitLongWords=1),
+    })
+
+
+def p(text,style='body'):
+    return Paragraph(text,STYLES[style])
+
+
+def code(text):
+    rows = [[p(escape(line) if line else ' ', 'mono')] for line in text.strip('\n').splitlines()]
+    out = Table(rows,colWidths=[WIDTH],hAlign='LEFT')
+    out.setStyle(TableStyle([('BACKGROUND',(0,0),(-1,-1),PALE),('BOX',(0,0),(-1,-1),.5,RULE),

+AUTHORSHIP AMENDMENT, LICENSE OPTIONS, AND SANDBOX STATUS
+21 October 2026
+
+The formalization authors are exactly, in manuscript order:
+  Matija Bucić
+  Fankang He
+  Hyunwoo Lee
+
+This attribution follows the user's explicit instruction. It is recorded in
+project.authors in formalization.yaml and in the project README. Bibliographic
+source authors retain the same three names. Automated assistance remains
+disclosed. This amendment does not assert a new human review or assign
+maintainership. project.responsible_maintainers remains an empty list.
+
+WHAT CHANGED AND WHAT WAS PRESERVED
+
+The metadata and two README files now reflect the assigned authors. This note,
+an integrity amendment, and a new metadata-check record were added. SHA256SUMS
+was refreshed for the updated package; its original contents are retained as
+verification/SHA256SUMS.original.txt.
+
+All 19 Lean source files, the dependency manifest and toolchain, Comparator
+configuration, workflows, verification scripts, original checker logs and JSON
+records, and the six-page PDF report are preserved byte for byte. No Lean build
+or kernel replay was rerun for this attribution-only amendment. Hash matching
+links the unchanged sources to the original recorded verification evidence;
+it does not independently repeat those proof checks.
+
+The PDF, its generator, verification/local-preflight.json, and
+verification/package-integrity.json describe the 20 October snapshot. Their
+references to unassigned authors are historical. This amendment and
+verification/authorship-update-integrity.json record the later change.
+verification/authorship-update-preflight.json records the new local check.
+The dependency cache is intentionally absent from the archive, so the local
+source preflight also reports the missing Mathlib checkout until dependencies
+are restored. The earlier source-pass record is preserved, not overwritten.
+
+ACTUAL LICENSE STATE
+
+project.license is still an empty string. No operative conventional root
+license file is present. LICENSE.proposed contains an unapplied Apache-2.0
+proposal and has not been promoted to LICENSE. Choosing authors does not
+choose a license. Responsible maintainers and licensing still need completion,
+so the metadata remains marked as a draft.
+
+The vendored metadata schema has its own Apache-2.0 license, retained in
+scripts/schemas/UPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt. No third-party Lean core or manuscript
+is bundled. The manuscript's license is recorded as unknown; dependencies
+retain their own terms. Any project license must respect rights in reused
+material and does not automatically relicense the paper or Mathlib.
+
+Palomar requires exactly one conventional root license file with one detectable
+standard SPDX license matching project.license exactly. Apache-2.0 is an
+example, not a mandatory choice. A bare SPDX label without the corresponding
+license text is not a substitute for a detectable standard license.
+
+SENSIBLE OPTIONS
+
+Apache-2.0 -- recommended default. Permits commercial reuse, private changes,
+and proprietary derivatives. Redistribution preserves the license and relevant
+notices, marks changes, and retains applicable NOTICE material if present.
+Includes an express contributor patent grant with patent-litigation
+termination. It matches Mathlib and Palomar's starter project, which makes
+future sharing of reusable lemmas straightforward.
+
+MIT -- a strong simpler alternative. Broad reuse, including commercial and
+proprietary reuse, subject to retaining copyright and permission notices in
+copies or substantial portions. Shorter than Apache-2.0, with no express
+patent-license clause.
+
+BSD-3-Clause -- similar permissive reuse with notice requirements, plus a
+clause preventing use of authors' names to endorse derived products without
+permission. No express patent-license clause.
+
+MPL-2.0 -- file-level copyleft. Distributed modifications to covered files
+remain available under MPL; those files can be combined with differently
+licensed code. Consider it if retaining openness of changes to these files
+matters more than unrestricted incorporation elsewhere.
+
+GPL-3.0-only or GPL-3.0-or-later -- stronger copyleft for distributed covered
+derivatives, with corresponding-source duties for object-code distribution.
+Commercial use and private modifications remain permitted. Reuse in an
+Apache-only library may need separate permission. This does not imply that
+every mathematical result using the project automatically becomes GPL.
+
+Creative Commons licenses suit prose better than Lean software; Creative
+Commons discourages applying its ordinary licenses to software. NC restricts
+commercial reuse; ND restricts sharing adaptations. A single standard software
+license is the clearest route for this repository. Releasing the paper is a
+separate choice.
+
+These choices preserve authorship; they grant reuse rights rather than assign
+copyright away. Legal notice requirements are distinct from a scholarly
+citation request. No license has been selected by this amendment.

+THE PRIOR COMPARATOR ERROR
+
+  bwrap: Can't mount proc on /newroot/proc: Operation not permitted
+
+Bubblewrap was creating the Linux sandbox and tried to mount its /proc
+filesystem. The operating system refused the operation. /newroot/proc names
+a location inside the temporary sandbox filesystem. This failure precedes the
+sandboxed comparison command; it is not a Lean type-checking error or a
+Challenge/Solution mismatch.
+
+The line identifies a host sandbox restriction but does not establish the
+exact cause. Nested containers, namespace permissions, security policy, or
+masked /proc paths can cause this symptom. It is insufficient evidence to
+identify one specific capability or seccomp rule as responsible.
+
+The retained comparator-vector.log belongs to an earlier attempt on the vector

+# Verification helpers
+
+From the project root, install Lean using `lean-toolchain`, then run:
+
+```sh
+lake exe cache get
+lake build
+lake env lean scripts/AxiomAudit.lean
+python3 -m pip install -r scripts/preflight-requirements.txt
+python3 scripts/preflight.py --json verification/local-preflight.json
+```
+
+`preflight.py` performs static local checks of module headers, physical source
+line limits, the Challenge size, prohibited proof-source tokens, Comparator
+configuration, the committed dependency manifest, and the exact local Mathlib
+revision and toolchain. It validates `formalization.yaml` against the vendored
+v0.4 JSON schema and adds Palomar's required human, provenance, license-file,
+classification, and draft-marker checks. It accepts deliberate `sorry` holes
+only in the configured Challenge module.
+
+The normal invocation fails if required human attribution is absent, metadata
+contains explicit draft placeholders, or a conventional root license has not
+been selected. It does not invent names or change metadata. A source-only run
+is available while these human decisions are pending:
+
+```sh
+python3 scripts/preflight.py --source-only --json verification/source-preflight.json
+```
+
+Source-only success says nothing about metadata or submission readiness. The
+default check validates fields and catches obvious automated-system names; it
+cannot authenticate a person's identity or their agreement to authorship.
+
+This script does not execute Lean, Comparator, the official SPDX license
+detector, or Palomar's full workflow. Its token scan is a diagnostic lexer,
+not a proof verifier. Exact license detection, authenticated upstream source
+resolution, taxonomy membership, and complete Challenge-import validation
+remain part of Palomar's full mechanical checks. A green local report is not
+registration or endorsement.
+
+`verify-comparator.sh` runs the toolchain's Comparator and independent kernels.
+`.github/workflows/lean.yml` provides separate Lean/source and metadata jobs.
+The submission snapshot records the three formalization authors, Matija Bucić
+as responsible maintainer, the AGPL-3.0 license, and arXiv source credit. The
+metadata job checks these completed fields. Original reports under
+`verification/` retain their earlier snapshot; later records are named separately.
+
+`.github/workflows/palomar-preflight.yml` provides the official reusable
+mechanical preflight at a pinned PalomarSubmission revision. Run it only after
+the intended exact snapshot has been pushed to a public repository. This is
+not an intake or registration request. The workflow reference and
+`pipeline_commit` must remain pinned to the same revision.
+
+The policy snapshot used by these local helpers was checked on 2026-10-20.
+`policy-provenance.json` records the authoritative URLs, immutable tool and
+schema revisions, and downloaded content hashes. The local metadata validator
+also checks the vendored schema's exact SHA-256 digest.
+Before actual submission, re-read the current official requirements and
+`https://submit.palomar-registry.org/llms.txt` and require a successful full
+mechanical preflight for the exact repository, commit, and Comparator config.
+

+`schemas/UPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt`; it continues to apply to that schema regardless

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Static local source/metadata checks for this Palomar preparation project.
+
+This is not a Lean build, Comparator run, licensee audit, or Palomar full
+mechanical preflight. It never submits, publishes, contacts a server, or changes
+the proof/metadata. Run after `lake exe cache get` so the pinned Mathlib checkout
+can be checked locally. Python 3.11+ is required.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tomllib
+from typing import Any
+
+
+POLICY_SNAPSHOT = "2026-10-20"
+MIN_TOOLCHAIN = "leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc2"
+SCHEMA_SHA256 = "25ff6b25ca4511635aff4443cf20480c15e59dddf19591c730950b442ea54fce"
+STANDARD_AXIOMS = {"propext", "Quot.sound", "Classical.choice"}
+COMPARATOR_KEYS = {
+    "challenge_module", "solution_module", "theorem_names", "definition_names",
+    "permitted_axioms", "enable_nanoda",
+}
+MODULE_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_']*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_']*)*")
+LICENSE_RE = re.compile(r"(?:licen[cs]e|copying|unlicense|ofl)(?:\.(?:md|markdown|txt))?", re.I)
+PROOF_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?<![\w'.])(?:sorry|admit|sorryAx|axiom|native_decide|Lean\.ofReduceBool)(?![\w'])"
+)
+DRAFT_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:DRAFT|TEMPLATE|TODO|TBD|UNRESOLVED|REPLACE_ME|PLACEHOLDER)\b")
+PLACEHOLDER_VALUE_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?:draft|template|todo|tbd|unresolved|replace[_ -]?me|placeholder|pending|unknown|unset|none)\b",
+    re.I,
+)
+GIT_URL_RE = re.compile(r"https://github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:\.git)?")
+COMPILED_SUFFIXES = {".olean", ".ilean", ".a", ".bc", ".dll", ".dylib", ".o", ".obj", ".so", ".trace"}
+
+
+class InvalidInput(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+def unique_mapping(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for key, value in pairs:
+        if key in result:
+            raise InvalidInput(f"duplicate mapping key: {key!r}")
+        result[key] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_mapping)
+
+
+def physical_lines(data: bytes) -> int:
+    # The policy counts LF/CRLF delimiters, not every Unicode line separator.
+    return data.count(b"\n") + int(bool(data) and not data.endswith(b"\n"))
+
+
+def mask_lean_comments_strings(source: str) -> tuple[str, list[int]]:
+    """Mask comments/strings while retaining offsets and newlines.
+
+    Handles nested Lean block comments, line comments, escaped strings and raw
+    strings. Module-doc comment offsets are retained for the header check.
+    This lexer is a diagnostic aid, not a substitute for Lean's parser/kernel.
+    """
+    out = list(source)
+    docs: list[int] = []
+    i, n = 0, len(source)
+
+    def erase(start: int, end: int) -> None:
+        for p in range(start, end):
+            if source[p] not in "\r\n":
+                out[p] = " "
+
+    while i < n:
+        if source.startswith("--", i):
+            end = source.find("\n", i)
+            end = n if end < 0 else end
+            erase(i, end)
+            i = end
+        elif source.startswith("/-", i):
+            start, depth = i, 1
+            if source.startswith("/-!", i):
+                docs.append(i)
+            i += 2
+            while i < n and depth:
+                if source.startswith("/-", i):
+                    depth += 1
+                    i += 2
+                elif source.startswith("-/", i):
+                    depth -= 1
+                    i += 2
+                else:
+                    i += 1
+            if depth:
+                raise InvalidInput("unterminated Lean block comment")
+            erase(start, i)
+        else:
+            raw = re.match(r'r(#+)"', source[i:]) if source[i] == "r" else None
+            if raw:
+                start = i
+                closing = '"' + raw.group(1)
+                end = source.find(closing, i + len(raw.group(0)))
+                if end < 0:
+                    raise InvalidInput("unterminated Lean raw string")
+                i = end + len(closing)
+                erase(start, i)
+            elif source[i] == '"':
+                start = i
+                i += 1
+                while i < n:
+                    if source[i] == "\\":
+                        i += 2
+                    elif source[i] == '"':
+                        i += 1
+                        break
+                    else:
+                        i += 1
+                else:
+                    raise InvalidInput("unterminated Lean string")
+                erase(start, min(i, n))
+            else:
+                i += 1
+    return "".join(out), docs
+
+
+def lean_version(value: str) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"leanprover/lean4:v(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:-rc(\d+))?", value)
+    if not match:
+        raise InvalidInput("toolchain must be a released Lean version or release candidate")
+    major, minor, patch, rc = match.groups()
+    return int(major), int(minor), int(patch), int(rc) if rc is not None else 1_000_000
+
+
+class Report:
+    def __init__(self, project: Path, source_only: bool):
+        self.project = project
+        self.source_only = source_only
+        self.errors: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+        self.warnings: list[str] = []
+        self.facts: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+    def fail(self, section: str, message: str) -> None:
+        self.errors.append({"section": section, "message": message})
+
+    def checked(self, section: str, task: Any) -> Any:
+        try:
+            return task()
+        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
+            self.fail(section, str(exc))
+            return None
+
+    def regular(self, relative: str, max_bytes: int | None = None) -> Path:
+        path = self.project / relative
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise InvalidInput(f"required regular file missing or symlinked: {relative}")
+        if max_bytes is not None and path.stat().st_size > max_bytes:
+            raise InvalidInput(f"{relative} exceeds {max_bytes} bytes")
+        return path
+
+
+def check_source(report: Report) -> None:
+    root = report.project
+    toolchain_path = report.checked("source", lambda: report.regular("lean-toolchain", 1024))
+    toolchain = toolchain_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() if toolchain_path else ""
+    if toolchain_path and not toolchain:
+        report.fail("source", "lean-toolchain must not be empty")
+    if toolchain:
+        report.facts["lean_toolchain"] = toolchain
+        version = report.checked("source", lambda: lean_version(toolchain))
+        if version is not None and version < lean_version(MIN_TOOLCHAIN):
+            report.fail("source", f"toolchain is below the {POLICY_SNAPSHOT} floor {MIN_TOOLCHAIN}")
+
+    lakefiles = [p for p in ("lakefile.toml", "lakefile.lean") if (root / p).exists()]
+    if len(lakefiles) != 1:
+        report.fail("source", "exactly one root lakefile.toml or lakefile.lean is required")
+    else:
+        lakefile = report.checked("source", lambda: report.regular(lakefiles[0], 1024**2))
+        if lakefile is not None and lakefile.suffix == ".toml":
+            report.checked("source", lambda: tomllib.loads(lakefile.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
+
+    config_path = report.checked("source", lambda: report.regular("comparator.json", 1024**2))
+    config = report.checked("source", lambda: load_json(config_path)) if config_path else None
+    challenge: Path | None = None
+    if isinstance(config, dict):
+        extras = set(config) - COMPARATOR_KEYS
+        if extras:
+            report.fail("source", f"unsupported Comparator fields: {sorted(extras)}")
+        modules = []
+        for field in ("challenge_module", "solution_module"):
+            name = config.get(field)
+            if not isinstance(name, str) or not MODULE_RE.fullmatch(name):
+                report.fail("source", f"Comparator {field} is not a safe dotted module name")
+                continue
+            modules.append(name)
+            relative = name.replace(".", "/") + ".lean"
+            path = report.checked("source", lambda r=relative: report.regular(r))
+            if field == "challenge_module":
+                challenge = path
+        if len(modules) == 2 and modules[0] == modules[1]:
+            report.fail("source", "Challenge and Solution must be distinct modules")
+        for field, required in (("theorem_names", True), ("definition_names", False)):
+            names = config.get(field, [] if not required else None)
+            if not isinstance(names, list) or (required and not names) or not all(
+                isinstance(name, str) and MODULE_RE.fullmatch(name) for name in names or []
+            ):
+                report.fail("source", f"invalid Comparator {field}")
+            elif len(set(names)) != len(names):
+                report.fail("source", f"duplicate Comparator {field}")
+        axioms = config.get("permitted_axioms")
+        if not isinstance(axioms, list) or not all(isinstance(a, str) and a in STANDARD_AXIOMS for a in axioms):
+            report.fail("source", "Comparator permitted_axioms must be a subset of the three standard axioms")
+        if "enable_nanoda" in config and type(config["enable_nanoda"]) is not bool:
+            report.fail("source", "Comparator enable_nanoda must be a boolean")
+    elif config is not None:
+        report.fail("source", "comparator.json must contain one JSON object")
+
+    manifest_path = report.checked("source", lambda: report.regular("lake-manifest.json", 1024**2))
+    manifest = report.checked("source", lambda: load_json(manifest_path)) if manifest_path else None
+    if isinstance(manifest, dict):
+        packages = manifest.get("packages")
+        if not isinstance(packages, list):
+            report.fail("source", "manifest packages must be a list")
+            packages = []
+        for package in packages:
+            if not isinstance(package, dict):
+                report.fail("source", "manifest package must be an object")
+                continue
+            if package.get("type") == "git":
+                if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", str(package.get("rev", ""))):
+                    report.fail("source", f"dependency {package.get('name')} lacks a full immutable Git SHA")
+                if not GIT_URL_RE.fullmatch(str(package.get("url", ""))):
+                    report.fail("source", f"dependency {package.get('name')} must use a credential-free public GitHub HTTPS URL")
+        mathlib = [p for p in packages if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("name") == "mathlib"]
+        if len(mathlib) != 1:
+            report.fail("source", "this project must have exactly one pinned Mathlib dependency")
+        else:
+            package = mathlib[0]
+            if str(package.get("url", "")).removesuffix(".git") != "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4":
+                report.fail("source", "Mathlib must come from its canonical repository")
+            location = (root / str(manifest.get("packagesDir", ".lake/packages")) / "mathlib").resolve()
+            if not location.is_relative_to(root):
+                report.fail("source", "Mathlib checkout path leaves the project directory")
+            elif not (location / "lean-toolchain").is_file():
+                report.fail("source", "pinned Mathlib checkout missing; run lake exe cache get first")
+            else:
+                selected = (location / "lean-toolchain").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+                if selected != toolchain:
+                    report.fail("source", "project toolchain differs from the resolved Mathlib toolchain")
+                def inspect_git() -> None:
+                    head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(location), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
+                        text=True, capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=20).stdout.strip()
+                    if head != package.get("rev"):
+                        raise InvalidInput("Mathlib checkout HEAD differs from lake-manifest.json")
+                    changed = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(location), "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"],
+                        text=True, capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=20).stdout
+                    if changed.strip():
+                        raise InvalidInput("Mathlib has modified tracked files")
+                    report.facts["mathlib_revision"] = head
+                    report.facts["mathlib_toolchain"] = selected
+                report.checked("source", inspect_git)
+    elif manifest is not None:
+        report.fail("source", "lake-manifest.json must contain one JSON object")
+
+    sources, total_size, challenge_holes = [], 0, 0
+    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
+        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in {".git", ".lake"} and not (Path(directory) / d).is_symlink()]
+        for name in sorted(files):
+            path = Path(directory) / name
+            relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+            if path.is_symlink():
+                if path.suffix == ".lean":
+                    report.fail("source", f"Lean source symlink is prohibited: {relative}")
+                continue
+            if not path.is_file():
+                continue
+            total_size += path.stat().st_size
+            if path.suffix.lower() in COMPILED_SUFFIXES:
+                report.fail("source", f"compiled artifact outside .lake: {relative}")
+            if path.suffix != ".lean":
+                continue
+            data = path.read_bytes()
+            count = physical_lines(data)
+            sources.append({"path": relative, "lines": count, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
+            if count > 10_000:
+                report.fail("source", f"{relative}: {count} physical lines exceeds 10,000")
+            try:
+                source = data.decode("utf-8")
+                masked, module_docs = mask_lean_comments_strings(source)
+            except (UnicodeError, InvalidInput) as exc:
+                report.fail("source", f"{relative}: {exc}")
+                continue
+            if name != "lakefile.lean":
+                header = re.match(r"\s*module\b", masked)
+                if header is None:
+                    report.fail("source", f"{relative}: missing module header before Lean commands")
+                elif any(pos < header.end() for pos in module_docs):
+                    report.fail("source", f"{relative}: module documentation must follow the module header")
+            for match in PROOF_TOKEN_RE.finditer(masked):
+                token = match.group()
+                if path == challenge and token in {"sorry", "admit"}:
+                    challenge_holes += 1
+                else:
+                    line = source.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
+                    report.fail("source", f"{relative}:{line}: forbidden proof-source token {token}")
+            if path == challenge:
+                if count > 1000 or len(data) > 100 * 1024:
+                    report.fail("source", "Challenge exceeds 1,000 lines or 100 KiB")
+                elif count > 300 or len(data) > 32 * 1024:
+                    report.warnings.append("Challenge exceeds the preferred 300-line/32-KiB audit surface")
+    if total_size > 500 * 1024**2:
+        report.fail("source", "local source snapshot excluding .git/.lake/symlinks exceeds 500 MiB")
+    if (root / ".gitmodules").exists():
+        report.fail("source", "submitted project must not contain Git submodules")
+    report.facts.update(source_files=sources, source_file_count=len(sources),
+        source_bytes=total_size, deliberate_challenge_holes=challenge_holes)

+def check_metadata(report: Report) -> None:

+    except ImportError as exc:

+
+    class StrictLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
+        pass
+
+    def strict_yaml_mapping(loader: Any, node: Any, deep: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:

+        for key, value in node.value:

+                raise InvalidInput("YAML merge keys are prohibited")
+            pairs.append((loader.construct_object(key, deep=deep), loader.construct_object(value, deep=deep)))
+        return unique_mapping(pairs)
+
+    StrictLoader.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG, strict_yaml_mapping)
+    path = report.checked("metadata", lambda: report.regular("formalization.yaml", 256 * 1024))
+    if path is None:

+    if re.search(r"(?m)^\s*#\s*(?:DRAFT|UNRESOLVED|TEMPLATE|TODO|TBD)\b", raw_metadata):

+    try:

+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):

+        return
+    schema_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "schemas/formalization-v0.4.schema.json"
+    schema = report.checked("metadata", lambda: load_json(schema_path))
+    if schema:

+        for error in sorted(Draft7Validator(schema).iter_errors(metadata), key=lambda e: str(list(e.path))):

+            report.fail("metadata", f"v0.4 schema {field}: {error.message}")

+
+    def visit(value: Any, field: str = "") -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            for key, child in value.items():
+                visit(child, f"{field}.{key}" if field else str(key))
+        elif isinstance(value, list):

+        elif isinstance(value, str):

+    visit(metadata)

+

+    else:

+                declared = re.findall(r"SPDX-License-Identifier:\s*([^\s]+)", contents)

+            except UnicodeError:

+

+
+    sources = metadata.get("sources")

+        if not original and not any(r in {"formalizes", "adapts", "independently-proves"} for r in relationships):

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Export the three Solution theorems and replay them with bundled kernels.
+
+Usage: python3 scripts/replay-kernels.py [--output DIRECTORY]
+Requires the pinned Lean toolchain, Lake dependencies, Python 3, and the
+leanexport, leanchecker, nanoda_bin, and con-ron binaries from that toolchain.
+Checks run sequentially; con-ron uses its verified mode with four workers.
+This records separate local checks. Palomar's sandboxed Comparator is a
+separate required verification step: scripts/verify-comparator.sh.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from collections import Counter
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+THEOREMS = [
+    'ErdosSzemeredi.vector_bound',
+    'ErdosSzemeredi.set_bound',
+    'ErdosSzemeredi.sunflower_conjecture',
+]
+AXIOMS = ['propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound']
+PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def digest(path: Path) -> str:
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as f:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def source_hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
+    paths = [PROJECT / name for name in
+             ['Solution.lean', 'Challenge.lean', 'lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json']]
+    paths += sorted((PROJECT / 'Sunflower').glob('*.lean'))
+    return {str(p.relative_to(PROJECT)): digest(p) for p in paths}
+
+
+def export_summary(path: Path) -> dict:
+    names = {0: ''}
+    records = Counter()
+    axioms, declarations, unsafe = [], set(), []
+    metadata = None
+    lines = 0
+    with path.open() as f:
+        for line in f:
+            lines += 1
+            obj = json.loads(line)
+            records[','.join(sorted(obj))] += 1
+            if 'meta' in obj:
+                metadata = obj['meta']
+            if 'in' in obj:
+                item = obj['str'] if 'str' in obj else obj['num']
+                prefix = names[item['pre']]
+                suffix = item.get('str', str(item.get('i', '')))
+                names[obj['in']] = (prefix + '.' if prefix else '') + suffix
+            for kind in ['axiom', 'def', 'thm', 'opaque', 'quot']:
+                if kind not in obj:
+                    continue
+                item = obj[kind]
+                name = names[item['name']]
+                declarations.add(name)
+                if kind == 'axiom':
+                    axioms.append(name)
+                if item.get('isUnsafe') or item.get('safety') == 'unsafe':
+                    unsafe.append(name)
+    return {
+        'metadata': metadata,
+        'ndjson_lines': lines,
+        'record_types': dict(records),
+        'axioms': axioms,
+        'unsafe_top_level_declarations': unsafe,
+        'requested_theorems_present': {name: name in declarations for name in THEOREMS},
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path,
+                        default=PROJECT / '.lake' / 'direct-kernel-audit')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    out = args.output.resolve()
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    lake = shutil.which('lake')
+    if lake is None:
+        raise SystemExit('Lake is required; install/select the pinned lean-toolchain first.')
+    subprocess.run([lake, 'build', 'Solution'], cwd=PROJECT, check=True)
+    prefix = Path(subprocess.check_output(
+        [lake, 'env', 'lean', '--print-prefix'], cwd=PROJECT, text=True).strip())
+    binary_dir = prefix / 'bin'
+    tool_names = ['lean', 'leanexport', 'leanchecker', 'nanoda_bin', 'con-ron']
+    for name in tool_names:
+        if not (binary_dir / name).is_file():
+            raise SystemExit(f'Required pinned-toolchain binary is missing: {binary_dir / name}')
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env['PATH'] = str(binary_dir) + os.pathsep + env.get('PATH', '')
+    result = {
+        'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        'scope': 'Fresh Solution dependency-closure export and separate direct kernel replay; '
+                 'Palomar sandboxed Comparator must be run separately.',
+        'project': str(PROJECT),
+        'theorems': THEOREMS,
+        'permitted_axioms': AXIOMS,
+        'toolchain': (PROJECT / 'lean-toolchain').read_text().strip(),
+        'binaries': {name: {'path': str(binary_dir / name),
+                           'sha256': digest(binary_dir / name)} for name in tool_names},
+        'source_sha256_before': source_hashes(),
+        'checks': {},
+    }
+    report = out / 'audit.json'
+
+    def save() -> None:
+        report.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+    export = out / 'solution.ndjson'
+    command = [lake, 'env', str(binary_dir / 'leanexport'), 'Solution', '--', *THEOREMS]
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    with export.open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'export.stderr.log').open('wb') as stderr:
+        p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=PROJECT, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
+    result['export'] = {'command': command, 'exit_code': p.returncode,
+                        'seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'path': str(export),
+                        'bytes': export.stat().st_size, 'sha256': digest(export)}
+    result['source_sha256_after'] = source_hashes()
+    result['sources_unchanged'] = result['source_sha256_before'] == result['source_sha256_after']
+    save()
+    if p.returncode or not result['sources_unchanged']:
+        print('Export failed or source files changed during export. See audit.json.', file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    summary = export_summary(export)
+    result['export_summary'] = summary
+    save()
+    if (set(summary['axioms']) - set(AXIOMS) or summary['unsafe_top_level_declarations']
+            or not all(summary['requested_theorems_present'].values())):
+        print('Export axiom, safety, or target-presence audit failed.', file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    config = {
+        'export_file_path': str(export), 'use_stdin': False,
+        'permitted_axioms': AXIOMS,
+        'unpermitted_axiom_hard_error': True,
+        'unsafe_permit_all_axioms': False,
+        'nat_extension': True, 'string_extension': True,
+        'num_threads': 4, 'print_success_message': True,
+    }
+    config_path = out / 'nanoda.json'
+    config_path.write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + '\n')
+    commands = [
+        ('leanchecker', [str(binary_dir / 'leanchecker'), '--from-export', str(export)]),
+        ('nanoda', [str(binary_dir / 'nanoda_bin'), str(config_path)]),
+        ('con-ron', [str(binary_dir / 'con-ron'), '--verified', '--jobs=4',
+                     '--progress=1000', str(export)]),
+    ]
+    for name, command in commands:
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        log = out / f'{name}.log'
+        with log.open('wb') as f:
+            p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=PROJECT, env=env, stdout=f, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        outcome = {'command': command, 'exit_code': p.returncode,
+                   'seconds': time.monotonic() - started,
+                   'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': digest(log)}
+        if name == 'nanoda':
+            outcome['configuration'] = config
+        result['checks'][name] = outcome
+        save()
+        print(json.dumps({'checker': name, 'exit_code': p.returncode,
+                          'seconds': outcome['seconds']}), flush=True)
+    result['finished_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    result['export_hash_unchanged'] = result['export']['sha256'] == digest(export)
+    result['all_checkers_exit_zero'] = all(
+        item['exit_code'] == 0 for item in result['checks'].values())
+    save()
+    return 0 if result['all_checkers_exit_zero'] and result['export_hash_unchanged'] else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())"},{"sha":"261eeb9e9f8b2b4b0d119366dda99c6fd7d35c64","filename":"scripts/schemas/UPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt","status":"added","additions":201,"deletions":0,"changes":201,"blob_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/blob/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/scripts%2Fschemas%2FUPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt","raw_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/raw/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/scripts%2Fschemas%2FUPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/contents/scripts%2Fschemas%2FUPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt?ref=8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,201 @@

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Judge Solution against Challenge the way Palomar does: with the `lake
+# comparator` that ships in this project's own toolchain, replaying the proof
+# through Lean's kernel and the toolchain's bundled independent kernels
+# (NanoDa and con-ron). Nothing is built from a pin; everything that judges
+# comes from `lean-toolchain`, which Palomar requires to be v4.35.0-rc2 or
+# later.
+repository_root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+cd "$repository_root"
+
+for required_command in bwrap lake lean python3; do
+  if ! command -v "$required_command" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "error: $required_command is required to run lake comparator" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+done
+
+toolchain=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < lean-toolchain)
+prefix=$(lean --print-prefix)
+for tool in lake leanexport leanchecker nanoda_bin con-ron; do
+  if [ ! -x "$prefix/bin/$tool" ]; then
+    echo "error: toolchain $toolchain does not bundle $tool" >&2
+    echo "Palomar requires leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc2 or later" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+done
+
+# Palomar ignores `enable_nanoda` and rejects `external_kernels` in a submitted
+# comparator.json: it registers the toolchain's bundled kernels itself. This
+# generated copy does the same, so the local check judges as the registry does.
+config=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/palomar-comparator.XXXXXX")
+trap 'rm -f "$config"' EXIT
+python3 - comparator.json "$config" "$prefix" <<'PY'
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+source, destination, prefix = sys.argv[1:]
+try:
+    config = json.loads(pathlib.Path(source).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+    print(f"error: cannot read valid Comparator config {source}: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+if not isinstance(config, dict):
+    print(f"error: {source} must contain one JSON object", file=sys.stderr)
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+if "external_kernels" in config:
+    print(f"error: {source}: external_kernels is not a submitter field; Palomar rejects it", file=sys.stderr)
+    raise SystemExit(1)
+config.pop("enable_nanoda", None)
+config["external_kernels"] = {
+    "nanoda": [f"{prefix}/bin/nanoda_bin"],
+    "con-ron": [f"{prefix}/bin/con-ron"],
+}
+pathlib.Path(destination).write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+PY

+Formal statement and proof-scope review
+20 October 2026
+
+Source: Bucić, He, and Lee, Proof of the Erdős-Szemerédi sunflower conjecture,
+attached 16-page manuscript. This review concerns its main Theorems 1 and 2,
+the usual no-prefactor Erdős-Szemerédi conclusion, and the proof chain used
+for them. It does not certify the separate literature assertions and
+applications in the introduction and concluding remarks, or the unpublished
+induced Erdős-Sauer reduction mentioned there.
+
+RESULT: No mathematical statement weakening, extra theorem hypothesis,
+nonstandard axiom, or proof hole was identified in the completed Solution.
+The source-level Challenge/Solution comparison passed for all three theorem
+headers and all six supporting definitions. Full Palomar sandboxed Comparator
+execution remains separately required because this environment cannot mount
+/proc in the required bubblewrap sandbox.
+
+1. Definitions and quantifiers
+The ground set Fin N has exactly N points; Fin D has exactly D alphabet symbols.
+Finite families are Finsets, so repeated family entries cannot inflate their
+cardinalities. Every forbidden sunflower consists of an injective Fin k-indexed
+tuple. SetPattern requires one common core equal to each intersection of two
+distinct indexed members. VectorPattern requires each coordinate to be either
+constant or injective. These are the manuscript's ordinary set and vector
+sunflower notions, with no ordering, balancedness, uniformity, or core-size
+restriction added.
+
+2. Exact public results
+ErdosSzemeredi.vector_bound assumes only k >= 3 and D >= 1, and a
+vector-sunflower-free family in (Fin D)^(Fin n). It proves cardinality <=
+[(4k^2)^(1/(k-1)) D^(1-1/(k-1))]^n. The formally checked auxiliary equality
+Sunflower.vectorBase_eq_manuscript identifies the first factor exactly with
+(2k)^(2/(k-1)), as printed in the manuscript. The formal result additionally
+allows n = 0; this strengthens its scope harmlessly.
+ErdosSzemeredi.set_bound assumes k >= 3, N >= 1, and an ordinary
+k-sunflower-free family of subsets of Fin N. It proves cardinality <=
+3 [2 - 1/(16k^3)]^N, exactly Theorem 1.
+ErdosSzemeredi.sunflower_conjecture states that for each k >= 3 there exists
+one real c with 0 < c < 2 such that every such family on every N >= k-1 points
+has cardinality <= c^N. The constant does not depend on N or the family.
+
+3. Crucial proof steps
+The common-space lemma uses the same finite family of functions for every
+non-anchor slice slot. Coefficient independence is a proved equality under
+arbitrary updates of the singled-out coordinate. Its annihilator contraction
+and injectivity/dimension bound are fully proved.
+The interpolation remainder is proved nonzero exactly on pairwise-distinct
+prefixes. Evaluation at repeated earlier values, polynomial degree bounds,
+telescoping, full local support, and coefficient independence are all proved.
+The formal construction omits the manuscript's conditional definition of an
+interpolation polynomial on repeated prefixes: the previous remainder already
+vanishes there, so the same recurrence and extracted terms remain valid.
+Grid interpolation preserves the singled-out low-power factor by deleting and
+reinserting that coordinate; all other exponents are strictly below D.
+Tensorization uses only the final m = k-1 rows for the low-coordinate choice.
+The common exponent family is exactly n <= m * (number of exponents < m), the
+integer form of at least ceil(n/m) low coordinates. The small-alphabet case is
+handled directly and does not assume a nonexistent nontrivial sunflower.
+The counting proof uses a finite weighted enumerator and (1+1/m)^m <= exp(1)
+to give the manuscript's Chernoff estimate. It first obtains the stronger
+constant 4(k-1)^2, then weakens to 4k^2. All conversions to real powers are proved.
+The vector-to-set step uses a finite transitive permutation-action double count,
+an injective encoding of block choices, and a fixed common remainder. It proves
+that vector sunflowers become set sunflowers. The t=0 case is handled explicitly
+by the one-element zero-coordinate cube, filling the manuscript's minor
+notational omission in invoking V_k(D,t) at t=0.
+The exact alphabet choice D=16k^2, ratio C/D=4^(-1/(k-1)), and all numerical
+inequalities yielding 1/(16k^3) are proved. The final absorption uses the explicit
+empty-set-plus-singletons sunflower to obtain strict cardinality < 2^N, a
+geometric tail estimate, and a maximum over finitely many small-size bases.
+
+4. Challenge fidelity and proof closure
+Challenge imports Mathlib only and declares its six mathematical definitions
+explicitly. Solution imports the completed proof modules and does not import
+Challenge. The theorem holes occur only in Challenge, as intended by the
+Challenge/Solution protocol. Whitespace-normalized comparisons confirm exact
+matches of all three theorem headers and all six definition bodies; the JSON
+record includes the source SHA-256 values.
+The fresh export contains the exact three advertised Solution theorem names.
+Its only axiom declarations are propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice.
+No unsafe top-level declaration was found. Direct replay passed the default
+Lean kernel, strict NanoDa, and con-ron in verified mode. This adds independent
+proof-checking evidence, while the full sandboxed source-to-statement
+Comparator remains a separate unfinished environmental check.
+
+5. Reporting limitations
+NanoDa reported zero typechecker errors, accepted 25,897 declarations, and
+returned exit code 0. Its log also contains the pretty-printer-only message
+"Unable to print axioms". The strict axiom allowlist and hard-error setting
+were enabled; direct parsing of the export independently confirmed exactly the
+three allowed axiom declarations. con-ron reported 24,461 accepted declarations;
+the count differs because the tools count inductive blocks, constructors,
+recursors, and quotient primitives differently. Original logs are retained.
+The checked version is Lean 4.35.0-rc2 with its pinned matching Mathlib revision.
+A blanket claim that all results and applications in the paper were formalized
+would exceed the checked scope."},{"sha":"2f573b7a4e8bdedfd20b52cfdaf89c78ab26b0ce","filename":"verification/leanchecker.log","status":"added","additions":1,"deletions":0,"changes":1,"blob_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/blob/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/verification%2Fleanchecker.log","raw_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/raw/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/verification%2Fleanchecker.log","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/contents/verification%2Fleanchecker.log?ref=8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1 @@

+module
+
+public import Mathlib
+
+/-!
+# Erdős–Szemerédi sunflower bounds: statement of record
+
+Source: Matija Bucić, Fankang He, and Hyunwoo Lee,
+*Proof of the Erdős-Szemerédi sunflower conjecture*, supplied manuscript,
+20 October 2026.  This module deliberately contains statement holes.
+`Solution.lean` proves the same declarations without importing this module.
+
+The alphabet is `Fin D` and the ground set is `Fin N`, equivalent to the
+manuscript's `[D]` and `[N]`.  Injectivity requires distinct sunflower members.
+The vector base `(4 k²)^(1/(k-1))` equals the manuscript's `(2k)^(2/(k-1))`.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Sunflower
+
+/-- All entries of a tuple agree. -/
+def Monochromatic {ι α : Type*} (x : ι → α) : Prop :=
+  ∀ i j, x i = x j
+
+/-- Each coordinate is constant or has pairwise distinct entries. -/
+def VectorPattern {k n D : ℕ} (x : Fin k → Fin n → Fin D) : Prop :=
+  ∀ r, Monochromatic (fun i => x i r) ∨ Function.Injective (fun i => x i r)
+
+/-- There are no `k` distinct members with the vector sunflower pattern. -/
+def VectorSunflowerFree (k : ℕ) {n D : ℕ} (V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D)) : Prop :=
+  ∀ x : Fin k → Fin n → Fin D,
+    (∀ i, x i ∈ V) → Function.Injective x → ¬ VectorPattern x
+
+/-- Every intersection of two distinct members is the same core. -/
+def SetPattern {k : ℕ} {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (x : Fin k → Finset α) : Prop :=
+  ∃ core : Finset α, ∀ i j, i ≠ j → x i ∩ x j = core
+
+/-- There are no `k` distinct sets forming a sunflower. -/
+def SetSunflowerFree (k : ℕ) {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
+    (F : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop :=
+  ∀ x : Fin k → Finset α, (∀ i, x i ∈ F) → Function.Injective x → ¬ SetPattern x
+
+/-- The constant in Theorem 2. -/
+noncomputable def vectorBase (k D : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  Real.rpow (4 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) (1 / ((k : ℝ) - 1)) *
+    Real.rpow (D : ℝ) (1 - 1 / ((k : ℝ) - 1))
+
+end Sunflower
+
+namespace ErdosSzemeredi
+
+/-- Theorem 2: a power saving in the alphabet size, for every fixed `k ≥ 3`.
+The formal statement also includes the harmless zero-coordinate case. -/
+theorem vector_bound (k n D : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hD : 1 ≤ D)
+    (V : Finset (Fin n → Fin D)) (hV : Sunflower.VectorSunflowerFree k V) :
+    (V.card : ℝ) ≤ Sunflower.vectorBase k D ^ n := by
+  sorry
+
+/-- Theorem 1: an explicit exponential improvement over the Boolean cube. -/
+theorem set_bound (k N : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
+    (F : Finset (Finset (Fin N))) (hF : Sunflower.SetSunflowerFree k F) :
+    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (2 - 1 / (16 * (k : ℝ) ^ 3)) ^ N := by
+  sorry
+
+/-- The usual conjecture: one base below two works for every admissible
+ground-set size.  The threshold `N ≥ k - 1` is essential. -/
+theorem sunflower_conjecture (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
+    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ c < 2 ∧
+      ∀ N : ℕ, k - 1 ≤ N → ∀ F : Finset (Finset (Fin N)),
+        Sunflower.SetSunflowerFree k F → (F.card : ℝ) ≤ c ^ N := by
+  sorry
+
+end ErdosSzemeredi"},{"sha":"0c97efd25b5974b974ed9a8a18207bc4f55bb338","filename":"LICENSE","status":"added","additions":235,"deletions":0,"changes":235,"blob_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/blob/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/LICENSE","raw_url":"https://github.com/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/raw/8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7/LICENSE","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/mbucic4/erdos-szemeredi-sunflowers/contents/LICENSE?ref=8b5dc7ba9fa9e64faad39a0ab5badf74cc89f8b7","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,235 @@

+
+**Formalization authors:** Matija Bucić, Fankang He, and Hyunwoo Lee.

+## Mathematical results
+
+A set sunflower consists of distinct sets whose pairwise intersections are
+one common core. A vector sunflower consists of distinct vectors such that
+each coordinate is either constant across all members or pairwise distinct.
+The formal definitions require injectivity of the entire indexed tuple, so
+repeated members cannot satisfy the forbidden configuration. They add no
+uniformity, ordering, core-size, or balancedness restriction.
+
